name: Joan Maquinano
bio: Bio nerd turned data nerd. Still an experimentalist at heart.
readme:
# Hi, i'm Maki! 🍣

**BS Biology graduate from UPLB, DOST scholar, former researcher, current Data & ESG Analyst, and aspiring Data Engineer. ✨**

I started out studying fish, biodiversity, and ecological data. Somewhere between research databases, species records, and sustainability reporting, I realized I enjoyed building and improving data systems just as much as studying the things inside them.

Today, I work with large-scale ESG datasets, obsess over data quality, and spend a questionable amount of time cleaning, validating, and transforming data so other people don't have to.

Currently documenting my journey from:

**biology → research → ESG data → data engineering**

## Work

- Data & ESG Analyst @ Institutional Shareholder Services (ISS)
- Former Research Assistant @ Quantitative Aquatics
- Former Digital Marketer @ 3rd Shift

## Building

- Data warehouse projects in Databricks
- Medallion Architecture pipelines
- Data quality and validation frameworks
- Analytics-ready datasets
- Tableau and Power BI dashboards

## Stack

**Data engineering**
- Databricks
- SQL
- Delta Lake
- Apache Spark

**Analytics**
- Tableau
- Power BI
- Excel
- Google Sheets

**Programming**
- SQL
- Python
- R

**Tools**
- GitHub
- Jira

## Featured case studies

### 🛒 Instacart Dimensional Warehouse
Dimensional data warehouse built in Databricks using a Raw → Clean → Mart architecture, star schema modeling, and validation checks.

🔗 Repository: https://github.com/jess-christine/instacart-pipeline

### 🎵 Chinook Dimensional Warehouse
Dimensional data warehouse built in Databricks using a Raw → Clean → Mart architecture, star schema modeling, and validation checks.

🔗 Repository: https://github.com/JoanMaquinano/chinook-dimensional-model

### 🛒 Retail Loyalty Pipeline
End-to-end pipeline processing retail transactions through Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.

🔗 Repository: https://github.com/JoanMaquinano/retail-loyalty-data-pipeline

### 🌊 Marine Sanctuary Impact Analysis
R-based analysis of long-term reef fish monitoring data used in a published marine conservation study.

🔗 Repository: https://github.com/JoanMaquinano/twinrocks-mpa-analysis

## Currently learning

- Apache Spark
- Data Quality Engineering
- CI/CD

*"building reliable data, one dataset at a time."*

repositories.name: retail-loyalty-data-pipeline
repositories.description: A Databricks SQL data pipeline project for processing Sari-Sari Store transaction data through Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, with data cleaning, validation, transformation, and dashboard-ready analytics.

repositories.name: chinook-dimensional-model
repositories.description: A dimensional data warehouse project developed in Databricks SQL using the Chinook dataset. The solution transforms source CSV files through Raw, Clean, and Mart layers to create analytics-ready data for sales reporting and business insights.

repositories.name: instacart-medallion-data-pipeline
repositories.description: Built an end-to-end data pipeline in Databricks using Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) to ingest, clean, transform, and model Instacart grocery order data into analytics-ready dimensional tables.

repositories.name: twinrocks-mpa-analysis
repositories.description: Analysis of long-term fish community trends in a marine sanctuary in the Verde Island Passage, examining how marine protection influences fish abundance, biomass, and body size over time.

repositories.name: Sarisari-store-data-cleaning
repositories.description: SQL data cleaning and transformation project in Databricks. Raw sales data was inspected, cleaned, standardized, deduplicated, and converted to proper data types to create a trusted Silver-layer table (silver.sarisari_sales) ready for analytics and reporting.

repositories.name: Monthly-Wholesale-Net-Revenue-Breakdown-Using-SQL
repositories.description: Developed a SQL-based sales analysis to measure monthly wholesale net revenue by product line and warehouse. Applied data aggregation, date transformations, and revenue calculations to uncover business insights, identify top-performing products, and compare warehouse performance.
